The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b90d91abec2e8614), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every d ≥ 3 and every 0 < κ < 2 √ d − 1, there is w0 = w0(d, κ) > 0 with the following property. For each fixed 0 < w < w0, the restriction of νd,w to an open neighborhood of Id,κ = [−2 √ d − 1 + κ, 2 √ d − 1 − κ] has a continuous density ρd,w, strictly positive on Id,κ. For every fixed E ∈ Id,κ, set Ξn,E = n X i=1 δnρd,w(E)(λi−E). Then, for every nonnegative f ∈ Cc(R), E exp  − Z f dΞn,E  − E exp  − Z f dΞGOE n  −→ 0 (2) as n → ∞ through all sizes n > d with nd even.
